definitions.explanation: A large fish of the same family as the yellowtail (ブリ), prized for sashimi and sushi for its firm, clean-tasting flesh.

examples.japanese: カンパチ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
カンパチ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ブリ→ブリ：32296_buri⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{脂|あぶら}→脂：01916_abura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧、⟦さっぱりしている→さっぱりする：26802_sapparisuru⟧。
examples.english: Greater amberjack is less fatty than yellowtail and tastes lighter.

examples.japanese: {鹿児島県|かごしまけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧カンパチ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{養殖|ようしょく}→養殖：08648_youshoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧で、⟦{一年中|いちねんじゅう}→一年中：17104_ichinenjuu⟧おいしいカンパチ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食|た}べられる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Kagoshima Prefecture farms a lot of greater amberjack, so you can eat good amberjack all year round.

notes:
WRITING:
Written {間八|かんぱち} in kanji, from the dark band across the head that looks like the character ⟦{八|はち}→八：00698_hachi⟧ seen from the front; usually written in katakana.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ブリ→ブリ：32296_buri⟧: Japanese amberjack, yellowtail; fattier, best in winter
- ⟦ハマチ→ハマチ：32308_hamachi⟧: young yellowtail
- ヒラマサ: yellowtail amberjack, the third fish of the family on sushi menus
